intuition: Feasibility is monotone: if Koko finishes at speed k, every higher speed also works.

brute_force.approach: Try every integer speed from one through the largest pile.

optimal.approach: Binary search the answer and sum each pile's ceiling division to test a candidate speed.

edge_cases: A speed equal to the largest pile handles every pile in at most one hour.
Ceiling division is needed for piles not divisible by the speed.
